title: DITA
summary: DITA, the Darwin Information Typing Architecture, is an open standard for structured, topic‑based authoring that lets teams write once and publish to multiple formats. It enables content reuse, consistent multi‑channel output, and automated workflows, reducing effort for technical writers managing large, evolving documentation sets.
